items.text: All 8 workshop decisions (4 from round 1, 4 from round 2) have been incorporated into plan.md. Round 2 decisions added: (1) new orchestrator Step 9 'Publish to LPBS' as the integration point, (2) repository placement in the deployments package, (3) JSON round-trip deserialization with local mirror types (PipelineDeployResult, PipelineBuildProvenance), and (4) deploy-stage-only pipeline trigger passing pre-built artifact paths.

Plan now includes a complete 4-phase implementation strategy, detailed contract definitions (schema, types, endpoint, repository interface), comprehensive testing plan covering deserialization and multi-platform scenarios, and a 10-file change manifest. All phases have concrete deliverables with no TBD sections remaining.

One potential gap flagged as a risk: scenario-to-desktop's support for selective stage execution (deploy-only) and accepting pre-built artifact paths as input needs verification before Phase 3 implementation. If unsupported, stage filtering would be a prerequisite. This is documented in the risk matrix with mitigation.

plan_updates: Incorporated all round 2 decisions: added orchestrator Step 9 details to Phase 3, added Phase 2 for local DeployResult types and JSON round-trip deserialization, specified repository placement in deployments package in Phase 1, added deploy-stage-only pipeline trigger config to Phase 3 and contract section, expanded testing plan with deserialization and multi-platform test cases, added pipeline_types.go and pipeline_types_test.go to file manifest, added two new risks for stage-filtering support and artifact path format.
